# What is MYX V2

**MYX V2 is the first perpetual market for any token.**

It is a permissionless on-chain protocol that allows spot demand to evolve naturally into perpetual markets, so users can trade, short, hedge, or use leverage on a token from day one.

At its core, MYX V2 is designed to make more assets tradable as real markets, rather than limiting derivatives trading to a small set of manually listed tokens.

### A new kind of perpetual market

Most perpetual trading platforms only offer a curated set of assets. MYX V2 takes a different approach.

Instead of treating perpetual markets as something that only appears after approval, MYX V2 is built so that markets can form permissionlessly when there is real demand and liquidity.

This makes MYX V2 more than a traditional perp exchange. It is a protocol layer for creating perpetual markets around on-chain assets.

### How MYX V2 is structured

MYX V2 is built around a few core components:

#### Permissionless market creation

Markets can be created for supported assets without relying on a centralized listing process.

#### Asset-pure vaults

Each market contains two independent liquidity vaults:

* **Base Vault** — holds the underlying asset
* **Quote Vault** — holds the stable quote asset

Liquidity providers choose which exposure they want. Base LPs remain exposed to the underlying asset, while Quote LPs remain exposed to stable capital. There is no forced rebalancing between the two.

When users deposit into either vault, they receive **mTokens**, which represent their share of that vault. These mTokens preserve the LP’s chosen exposure while allowing the position to accrue value from trading activity. In this way, mTokens turn deposited assets into productive market liquidity without changing the underlying asset preference of the LP.

The vaults underwrite only the residual exposure that remains after trader positions net against each other.

#### On-chain execution and settlement

Trading, margining, and settlement are handled by smart contracts on-chain, making the core market rules transparent and verifiable.

### How to think about MYX V2

The simplest way to understand MYX V2 is this:

**MYX V2 is a protocol where tokens can become perpetual markets.**

It brings together:

* spot demand
* liquidity
* perpetual trading
* and on-chain settlement

into one system.

In short, MYX V2 is:

**a permissionless on-chain perpetual market protocol for any token.**

Examples: * ETH * BTC * BNB > 📌 Deposits must match the vault’s asset type *** ### Step 2 — Select Base Vault **↓There are three ways to find your base** * In the Cook area, find your Base Vault. * In the Trench area, find your Base Vault. * Use search bar, find your Base Vault. *** ### Step 4 — Enter Deposit Amount 1. Review: * Estimated share *** ### Step 5 — Confirm Deposit * Click **Subscribe / Deposit** * Approve the transaction in your wallet *** ### Step 6 — Receive mLP Tokens After confirmation: * Your assets enter the vault * You receive **mLP tokens** representing your share *** ### What Happens After Deposit *** #### Asset Exposure * You remain fully exposed to the asset price * Example: * ETH goes up → your position value increases *** #### Yield Generation You earn from: * Trading fees * Funding fees 👉 Earnings are mostly **auto-compounded into NAV** *** #### Market Impact * Your liquidity increases **Index Liquidity** * Enables more **short positions** *** ### Key Characteristics * No asset swapping → no impermanent loss * Full directional exposure * Passive yield generation ***

Navigate to **Vault** 2. Locate your LP position *** ### Step 2 — Click Redeem * Select the position * Click **Redeem** *** ### Step 3 — Enter Redemption Amount 1. Input the amount of mLP to redeem 2. Review: * Estimated assets received * Current exchange rate *** ### Step 4 — Check Available Liquidity Redemption depends on vault liquidity. *** #### Why? * The system prioritizes trader settlement * Part of liquidity may be reserved when the market is imbalanced (NUP) *** #### Result * You may redeem: * Full amount (if liquidity is sufficient) * Partial amount (if liquidity is constrained) > 📌 Remaining liquidity becomes available as the market rebalances *** ### Step 5 — Genesis LP Option (If Applicable) If you are a Genesis LP, you will see: 👉 **“Retain Genesis LP Share” option** *** #### If Enabled * You keep your Genesis status * Continue receiving **2% fee bonus** *** #### If Disabled * You fully exit * You **permanently lose Genesis benefits** > ⚠️ This action cannot be reversed *** ### Step 6 — Confirm Redemption * Click **Confirm** * Approve the transaction *** ### What You Receive * Base Vault → index asset (e.g. ETH, BTC) * Quote Vault → stablecoins (USDC / USDT) *** ### Key Considerations *** #### Liquidity Conditions * Balanced market → smooth redemption * High skew → partial redemption *** #### Market Impact * Large withdrawals may take longer to fully process * Availability improves as positions close *** #### Genesis Trade-Off | Choice | Result | | -------------- | ---------------------------- | | Retain Genesis | Keep long-term fee advantage | | Full Exit | Lose Genesis permanently | ***

# How to Claim Income

MYX V2 uses an auto-compounding model where fees are reinvested into the NAV (Net Asset Value) of your mLP.

1. **Dashboard**: View your "Unclaimed Profits" on the Portfolio page.
2. **Claim**: Click the **"Claim"** button to withdraw realized fees (Trading Fees + Funding Fees) directly to your wallet.
3. **Auto-Compound**: Alternatively, keep your funds in the vault to benefit from the continuous growth of mLP value.

# Risks

### Overview

LP exposure tells you what can affect LP token NAV.\
Risk explains the conditions under which that exposure can become adverse, or when LP capital may be unable to function as expected.

On MYX, LP risk can be understood in three broad categories:

1. **Economic Risks**
2. **Liquidity & Exit Risks**
3. **Protocol & Infrastructure Risks**

This structure is useful because not all LP risks come from market direction. Some come from the ability to exit, and some come from the reliability of the system itself.

***

### 1. Economic Risks

Economic risks are the risks that can directly affect LP token NAV or LP total return.

#### Trader PnL Risk

The core economic risk of LPing on MYX is exposure to trader PnL.

When the vault underwrites residual trader exposure:

* trader losses may benefit LP NAV
* trader gains may reduce LP NAV

This is the main underwriting risk LPs take in exchange for earning from market activity.

***

#### Underlying Asset Risk

This applies primarily to **base vaults**.

If the vault holds the underlying token, LP token NAV remains exposed to the price of that asset.

This means base-vault LPs are exposed to:

* trader PnL
* plus the underlying asset’s own price movement

That makes base-vault LPing more directional than stable-vault LPing.

***

#### Yield Variability Risk

LP returns are not fixed.

Even if LP NAV remains stable over a period of time, actual realized return can vary depending on:

* trading volume
* funding flow
* slippage compensation
* vault utilization
* market imbalance

This means a market can look attractive during one period and much less attractive during another, even if TVL remains similar.

Yield variability is therefore a core LP risk: expected income may fluctuate meaningfully over time.

***

### 2. Liquidity & Exit Risks

These risks do not always reduce NAV immediately, but they affect how easily LP capital can be redeemed or repositioned.

#### LP Liquidity Risk

LP capital may not always be freely redeemable at all times.

When vault utilization is high, more capital is actively supporting market exposure. In those conditions, immediate withdrawal capacity may be reduced.

This means LPs may face:

* reduced exit flexibility
* delayed redemption capacity
* temporary capital lock during active market stress

For LPs, this is one of the most practical risks to monitor.

***

#### Network Stability Risk

MYX operates on-chain, so LP activity depends on network conditions.

If the network becomes congested, unstable, or temporarily unavailable, LPs may be unable to:

* deposit
* redeem
* claim income
* react to changing conditions in time

This does not necessarily create losses by itself, but it can amplify losses or reduce the ability to manage them.

***

### 3. Protocol & Infrastructure Risks

These risks come from the protocol stack itself rather than from market direction.

#### Smart Contract Risk

As with any on-chain system, LP capital is exposed to smart contract risk.

Even with audits and testing, smart contracts can still contain vulnerabilities or fail in unexpected conditions.

For LPs, this is a low-frequency but high-severity risk, because vault capital remains inside the protocol.

***

#### Keeper / Operational Risk

MYX relies on keepers and protocol operations to maintain normal market function.

If keepers become inactive, delayed, or fail to perform required actions, this may affect:

* liquidation handling
* state transitions
* tracker updates
* protocol responsiveness during stress

This is not the same as direct custody risk, but it can create losses if the system cannot react properly when it needs to.

***

#### Oracle / Pricing Infrastructure Risk

MYX execution and settlement depend on pricing infrastructure.

If oracle data becomes stale, delayed, or temporarily inconsistent with the broader market, this may affect:

* execution quality
* liquidation timing
* trader PnL settlement
* LP exposure realization

The protocol includes protections for pricing integrity, but LPs should still recognize oracle and pricing infrastructure as part of the system’s risk surface.

***

### Summary

A useful way to think about LP risk is:

#### Economic Risks

Can the market activity you are underwriting reduce NAV or reduce expected return?

#### Liquidity & Exit Risks

Can you redeem or reposition your capital when you want to?

#### Protocol & Infrastructure Risks

Can the system continue functioning correctly under stress?

Together, these define the real LP risk profile.

self._pools[poolId];\n\n        poolMetadata.riskTier = riskTier;\n        poolMetadata.state = PoolState.Trench;\n    }\n\n    function updatePoolState(Data storage self, PoolId poolId, PoolState state) internal {\n        self._pools[poolId].state = state;\n    }\n\n    function updateCompoundEnabled(Data storage self, PoolId poolId, bool compoundEnabled) internal {\n        self._pools[poolId].compoundEnabled = compoundEnabled;\n    }\n\n    function updateRiskTier(Data storage self, PoolId poolId, uint8 riskTier) internal {\n        self._pools[poolId].riskTier = riskTier;\n    }\n\n    function poolExists(Data storage self, PoolId poolId) internal view returns (bool) {\n        return self._poolIds.contains(PoolId.unwrap(poolId));\n    }\n\n    function getPoolIds(Data storage self) internal view returns (bytes32[] memory poolIds) {\n        return self._poolIds.values();\n    }\n\n    function getPool(Data storage self, PoolId poolId) internal view returns (PoolMetadata memory) {\n        return self._pools[poolId];\n    }\n\n    function getPoolMarketId(Data storage self, PoolId poolId) internal view returns (MarketId) {\n        return self._pools[poolId].marketId;\n    }\n\n    function isPoolAddress(Data storage self, PoolId poolId, address addr) internal view returns (bool) {\n        return self._pools[poolId].poolVault == addr || self._pools[poolId].tradingVault == addr;\n    }\n\n    function getPoolVault(Data storage self, PoolId poolId) internal view returns (address) {\n        return self._pools[poolId].poolVault;\n    }\n\n    function getTradingVault(Data storage self, PoolId poolId) internal view returns (address) {\n        return self._pools[poolId].tradingVault;\n    }\n\n    function getPoolRiskTier(Data storage self, PoolId poolId) internal view returns (uint8) {\n        return self._pools[poolId].riskTier;\n    }\n\n    function getMarketPool(Data storage self, MarketId marketId, address asset) internal view returns (PoolMetadata memory) {\n        return self._pools[self._marketAssetPoolIds[marketId][asset]];\n    }\n}\n\nlibrary LibPoolMetadata {\n    function isPoolInitialized(PoolMetadata memory self) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        return self.baseToken != address(0);\n    }\n\n    function isCooked(PoolMetadata memory self) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        return self.state == PoolState.Cook;\n    }\n\n    function isBoosted(PoolMetadata memory self) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        return self.state == PoolState.Boosted;\n    }\n\n    function isPrimed(PoolMetadata memory self) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        return self.state == PoolState.Primed;\n    }\n\n    function isTrench(PoolMetadata memory self) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        return self.state == PoolState.Trench;\n    }\n\n    function isPreBench(PoolMetadata memory self) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        return self.state == PoolState.PreBench;\n    }\n\n    function isBench(PoolMetadata memory self) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        return self.state == PoolState.Bench;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x4947880c9a1a8c91fd5f61c7d9308d8d3c412c5c901d40a43f2c90b1c0d8059a","license":"BUSL-1.1"},"myx-contract-v2/src/libraries/TradingHelper.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport { IERC20Metadata } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/IERC20Metadata.sol\";\nimport { SafeCast } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/SafeCast.sol\";\nimport { SignedMath } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/SignedMath.sol\";\nimport { IPoolVault } from \"./../interfaces/IPoolVault.sol\";\nimport { IPositionManager } from \"./../interfaces/IPositionManager.sol\";\nimport { Constants, PoolMetadata, PoolId, Operation, Direction } from \"./../types/Types.sol\";\nimport { PrecisionUtils } from \"./../utils/PrecisionUtils.sol\";\nimport { TradeUtils } from \"./../utils/TradeUtils.sol\";\n\n/// @title TradingHelper\n/// @notice Helper library for trading calculations and token conversions\nlibrary TradingHelper {\n    using PrecisionUtils for uint256;\n    using PrecisionUtils for int256;\n    using SignedMath for int256;\n    using SafeCast for uint256;\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Converts an amount from one ERC20 token's decimal format to another.\n     *\n     * @dev This function normalizes the `source` token amount to 18 decimals (Wad),\n     * then converts it to the `target` token's native decimal format.\n     * It's useful for standardizing calculations between tokens with different decimals.\n     *\n     * Example:\n     * - source = USDC (6 decimals), target = WETH (18 decimals), amount = 1_000_000 (1 USDC)\n     * → returns: 1e18 (1 WETH-style unit)\n     *\n     * @param source   The ERC20 token address of the source asset\n     * @param target   The ERC20 token address of the target asset\n     * @param amount   The amount denominated in `source` token's native decimals\n     * @return         The equivalent amount in `target` token's native decimals\n     */\n    function convertTokenAmount(address source, address target, uint256 amount) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint8 targetDecimals = IERC20Metadata(target).decimals();\n        return convertTokenToDecimals(source, targetDecimals, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Convert token amount to specific decimals\n    /// @param source Source token address\n    /// @param targetDecimals Target decimal precision\n    /// @param amount Amount to convert\n    /// @return Converted amount\n    function convertTokenToDecimals(address source, uint8 targetDecimals, uint256 amount) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint8 sourceDecimals = IERC20Metadata(source).decimals();\n        return amount.toWad(sourceDecimals).fromWad(targetDecimals);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Convert amount from specific decimals to target token format\n    /// @param sourceDecimals Source decimal precision\n    /// @param target Target token address\n    /// @param amount Amount to convert\n    /// @return Converted amount\n    function convertTokenFromDecimals(uint8 sourceDecimals, address target, uint256 amount) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint8 targetDecimals = IERC20Metadata(target).decimals();\n        return amount.toWad(sourceDecimals).fromWad(targetDecimals);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Convert amount from specific decimals to target token format\n    /// @param sourceDecimals Source decimal precision\n    /// @param targetDecimals Target decimal precision\n    /// @param amount Amount to convert\n    /// @return Converted amount\n    function convertTokenAmount(uint8 sourceDecimals, uint8 targetDecimals, uint256 amount) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        return amount.toWad(sourceDecimals).fromWad(targetDecimals);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Validate order size\n    /// @param pool Pool metadata\n    /// @param minTradeUsd Minimum trade size in USD\n    /// @param orderSize Order size\n    /// @param marketPrice Market price\n    /// @return True if order size is valid\n    function validateOrderSize(PoolMetadata memory pool, uint256 minTradeUsd, uint256 orderSize, uint256 marketPrice) internal view returns (bool) {\n        uint256 minTradeSize = TradingHelper.convertTokenFromDecimals(\n            Constants.USD_DECIMALS,\n            pool.baseToken,\n            minTradeUsd.divPrice(marketPrice)\n        );\n        return orderSize >= minTradeSize;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Calculate PnL for a position\n    /// @param poolMetadata Pool metadata containing token addresses\n    /// @param entryPrice Position entry price\n    /// @param exitPrice Position exit price\n    /// @param size Position size\n    /// @param isLong Whether position is long\n    /// @return pnl Calculated profit/loss\n    function calculatePNL(\n        PoolMetadata memory poolMetadata,\n        uint256 entryPrice,\n        uint256 exitPrice,\n        uint256 size,\n        bool isLong\n    ) internal view returns (int256 pnl) {\n        int256 pnlSize = TradeUtils.calculatePNLSize(entryPrice, exitPrice, size, isLong);\n        uint256 pnlAbs = convertTokenAmount(poolMetadata.baseToken, poolMetadata.quoteToken, pnlSize.abs());\n        return pnlSize >= 0 ? pnlAbs.toInt256() : -pnlAbs.toInt256();\n    }\n\n    function calculateFundingFee(\n        PoolMetadata memory poolMetadata,\n        int256 accruedFundingTracker,\n        uint256 positionSize,\n        Direction direction\n    ) internal view returns (int256) {\n        int256 fundingFeeSize = TradeUtils.calculateFundingFeeSize(accruedFundingTracker, positionSize, direction);\n        uint256 unsigned = convertTokenAmount(poolMetadata.baseToken, poolMetadata.quoteToken, fundingFeeSize.abs());\n        return fundingFeeSize >= 0 ? unsigned.toInt256() : -unsigned.toInt256();\n    }\n\n    function makeableSize(IPositionManager positionManager, PoolId poolId, Operation operation, Direction direction) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        IPositionManager.OITracker memory oi = positionManager.getOITracker(poolId);\n        uint256 longTracker = oi.longSize;\n        uint256 shortTracker = oi.shortSize;\n\n        bool isBuy = TradeUtils.getOrderSide(operation, direction);\n        if (isBuy) {\n            return shortTracker > longTracker ? shortTracker - longTracker : 0;\n        } else {\n            return longTracker > shortTracker ? longTracker - shortTracker : 0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    function availableLiquiditySize(\n        PoolId poolId,\n        IPoolVault poolVault,\n        IPositionManager positionManager,\n        uint32 baseReserveRatio,\n        uint32 quoteReserveRatio,\n        Operation operation,\n        Direction direction,\n        uint256 executePrice\n    ) internal view returns (uint256 availableSize) {\n        IPoolVault.PoolReserve memory reserve = poolVault.reserveInfo();\n        IPositionManager.OITracker memory oiTracker = positionManager.getOITracker(poolId);\n\n        bool isBuy = TradeUtils.getOrderSide(operation, direction);\n        bool isLongBiased = oiTracker.tracker >= 0;\n\n        uint8 baseDecimals = IERC20Metadata(poolVault.baseToken()).decimals();\n        uint8 quoteDecimals = IERC20Metadata(poolVault.quoteToken()).decimals();\n\n        uint256 availableSizeWad = _availableLiquiditySizeWad(\n            reserve.baseTotalAmount.toWad(baseDecimals),\n            reserve.quoteTotalAmount.toWad(quoteDecimals),\n            reserve.baseReservedAmount.toWad(baseDecimals),\n            reserve.quoteReservedAmount.toWad(quoteDecimals),\n            baseReserveRatio,\n            quoteReserveRatio,\n            isLongBiased,\n            oiTracker.tracker.toWad(baseDecimals),\n            isBuy,\n            executePrice\n        );\n        return availableSizeWad.fromWad(baseDecimals);\n    }\n\n    function _availableLiquiditySizeWad(\n        uint256 baseTotalAmountWad,\n        uint256 quoteTotalAmountWad,\n        uint256 baseReservedAmountWad,\n        uint256 quoteReservedAmountWad,\n        uint32 baseReserveRatio,\n        uint32 quoteReserveRatio,\n        bool isLongBiased,\n        int256 trackerWad,\n        bool isBuy,\n        uint256 executePrice\n    ) private pure returns (uint256 availableSize) {\n        uint256 unreservedBase = baseTotalAmountWad > baseReservedAmountWad ? baseTotalAmountWad - baseReservedAmountWad : 0;\n        uint256 unreservedQuote = quoteTotalAmountWad > quoteReservedAmountWad ? quoteTotalAmountWad - quoteReservedAmountWad : 0;\n        if (isLongBiased) {\n            if (isBuy) {\n                uint256 unreservedQuoteSize = unreservedQuote.divPrice(\n                    executePrice.mulPrecision(quoteReserveRatio, Constants.RESERVE_RATIO_PRECISION)\n                );\n                availableSize = unreservedBase + unreservedQuoteSize;\n            } else {\n                uint256 quoteSize = quoteTotalAmountWad.divPrice(executePrice);\n                uint256 baseSize = baseTotalAmountWad.divPrecision(baseReserveRatio, Constants.RESERVE_RATIO_PRECISION);\n                availableSize = uint256(trackerWad) + quoteSize + baseSize;\n            }\n        } else {\n            if (isBuy) {\n                uint256 quoteSize = quoteTotalAmountWad.divPrice(executePrice.mulPrecision(quoteReserveRatio, Constants.RESERVE_RATIO_PRECISION));\n                availableSize = trackerWad.abs() + baseTotalAmountWad + quoteSize;\n            } else {\n                uint256 unreservedQuoteSize = unreservedQuote.divPrice(executePrice);\n                availableSize = unreservedQuoteSize + unreservedBase.divPrecision(baseReserveRatio, Constants.RESERVE_RATIO_PRECISION);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xf4fbd78acef07691d4cf8a0bc34973d2d1116471f357e9cbe7f0272be3c22cb8","license":"BUSL-1.1"},"myx-contract-v2/src/misc/base/BaseContract.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: return _getContextStorage()._dependencyAddresses[identifier];\n    }\n\n    function _registerDependencies(bytes32[] memory identifiers) internal {\n        ContextStorage storage $ = addressManager.getAddresses(identifiers);\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < identifiers.length; ++i) {\n            $._dependencyAddresses[identifiers[i]] = contractAddresses[i];\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _getContextStorage() private pure returns (ContextStorage storage $) {\n        assembly {\n            $.slot := CONTEXT_STORAGE_LOCATION\n        }\n        return $;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xa611586a19237664e9a2d3214cc73f10e2944b7ac60da583f138cfb91f596e81","license":"BUSL-1.1"},"myx-contract-v2/src/misc/base/BaseContractUpgradeable.sol":{"content":"// BUSL-1.1\npragma solidity ^0.8.30;\n\nimport { ReentrancyGuardUpgradeable } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts-upgradeable/utils/ReentrancyGuardUpgradeable.sol\";\nimport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport { SafeERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport { SignedMath } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/SignedMath.sol\";\nimport { IBasePool } from \"./../interfaces/IBasePool.sol\";\nimport { IEmiter } from \"./../interfaces/IEmiter.sol\";\nimport { IExchangeCallback } from \"./../interfaces/IExchangeCallback.sol\";\nimport { IPoolToken } from \"./../interfaces/IPoolToken.sol\";\nimport { IPoolVault } from \"./../interfaces/IPoolVault.sol\";\nimport { IRiskParameter } from \"./../interfaces/IRiskParameter.sol\";\nimport { ITradingVault } from \"./../interfaces/ITradingVault.sol\";\nimport { Identifier } from \"./../libraries/Identifier.sol\";\nimport { LibPoolMetadata } from \"./../libraries/Pool.sol\";\nimport { TradingHelper } from \"./../libraries/TradingHelper.sol\";\nimport { Constants, Errors, PoolMetadata, PoolId } from \"./../types/Types.sol\";\nimport { PrecisionUtils } from \"./../utils/PrecisionUtils.sol\";\nimport { PoolBase } from \"./PoolBase.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title BasePool\n * @notice Base pool contract for handling base token liquidity provision and management\n * @dev This contract manages base token deposits/withdrawals, rebate distribution, and LP token minting/burning.\n * It supports profit distribution to liquidity providers through a rebate mechanism and handles exchange rates\n * for LP tokens based on the underlying base token reserves.\n */\ncontract BasePool is PoolBase, ReentrancyGuardUpgradeable, IBasePool {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n    using LibPoolMetadata for PoolMetadata;\n    using PrecisionUtils for uint256;\n    using SignedMath for int256;\n\n    // Mapping from pool ID to pool data containing rebate indices\n    mapping(PoolId poolId => PoolData poolData) private _poolDatas;\n    // Mapping from pool ID and user address to user-specific rebate data\n    mapping(PoolId poolId => mapping(address account => UserData userData)) private _userDatas;\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Emitted when profits are distributed to the base pool\n     * @param poolId The ID of the pool receiving the profit distribution\n     * @param baseAmount Amount of base tokens distributed\n     * @param quoteAmount Amount of quote tokens distributed\n     * @param price Current oracle price used for distribution calculations\n     * @param exchangeRate Current exchange rate of LP tokens to base tokens\n     * @param rebateIndex Updated global rebate index for quote token rebates\n     * @param genesisRebateIndex Updated global rebate index for genesis quote token rebates\n     */\n    event BasePoolProfitDistributed(\n        PoolId indexed poolId,\n        uint256 baseAmount,\n        uint256 quoteAmount,\n        uint256 price,\n        uint256 exchangeRate,\n        uint256 rebateIndex,\n        uint256 genesisRebateIndex\n    );\n\n    event PoolRebateIndexUpdated(PoolId indexed poolId, uint256 unexchangedProfits, uint256 oldIndex, uint256 newIndex);\n\n    event PoolProfitExchanged(PoolId indexed poolId, uint256 baseIn, uint256 quoteOut, uint256 price, address recipient);\n\n    error ExceedMaxProfit();\n\n    modifier onlyPoolVault(PoolId poolId) {\n        _onlyPoolVault(poolId);\n        _;\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyPoolManager() {\n        _onlyPoolManager();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /// @custom:oz-upgrades-unsafe-allow constructor\n    constructor() {\n        _disableInitializers();\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function initialize(address addressManager) external initializer {\n        __ReentrancyGuard_init();\n        __PoolBase_init(addressManager);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function getPoolData(PoolId poolId) external view override returns (PoolData memory) {\n        return _poolDatas[poolId];\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function getUserData(PoolId poolId, address user) external view override returns (UserData memory) {\n        return _userDatas[poolId][user];\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function previewLpAmountOut(PoolId poolId, uint256 baseAmountIn, uint256 price) external view returns (uint256) {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        uint256 exchangeRate = _getExchangeRate(pool, poolId, price);\n        return _getLpAmountOut(pool, baseAmountIn, exchangeRate);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function previewBaseAmountOut(PoolId poolId, uint256 lpAmountIn, uint256 price) external view returns (uint256) {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        uint256 exchangeRate = _getExchangeRate(pool, poolId, price);\n        return _getBaseAmountOut(pool, lpAmountIn, exchangeRate);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function withdrawableLpAmount(PoolId poolId, uint256 price) external view returns (uint256) {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        IPoolVault.PoolReserve memory reserveInfo = IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).reserveInfo();\n\n        uint256 withdrawableBase = reserveInfo.baseTotalAmount - reserveInfo.baseReservedAmount;\n        uint256 exchangeRate = _getExchangeRate(pool, poolId, price);\n        return _getLpAmountOut(pool, withdrawableBase, exchangeRate);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function previewUserWithdrawData(\n        PoolId poolId,\n        uint256 lpAmountIn,\n        address user,\n        uint256 price\n    ) external view returns (uint256 baseAmountOut, uint256 rebateAmount) {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        uint256 exchangeRate = _getExchangeRate(pool, poolId, price);\n        (uint256 rebates, uint256 genesisRebates) = pendingUserRebates(poolId, user, price);\n        return (_getBaseAmountOut(pool, lpAmountIn, exchangeRate), rebates + genesisRebates);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function pendingUserRebates(PoolId poolId, address user, uint256 price) public view override returns (uint256 rebates, uint256 genesisRebates) {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        (uint256 _rebates, uint256 _genesisRebates) = _pendingUserBaseRebate(pool, poolId, price, user);\n        UserData memory userData = _userDatas[poolId][user];\n\n        rebates = userData.accrued + _rebates;\n        genesisRebates = userData.genesisAccrued + _genesisRebates;\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function getExchangeableProfit(PoolId poolId, uint256 price) external view override returns (uint256 baseIn, uint256 quoteOut) {\n        return _exchangeableProfit(poolId, price);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function previewExchangeableProfit(PoolId poolId) external view override returns (uint256 baseIn, uint256 quoteOut) {\n        uint256 oraclePrice = _getOracle().safeOraclePrice(poolId);\n        return _exchangeableProfit(poolId, oraclePrice);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function deposit(\n        PoolId poolId,\n        uint256 amountIn,\n        uint256 minAmountOut,\n        address user,\n        address recipient\n    ) external override nonReentrant returns (uint256 amountOut) {\n        require(user == msg.sender || _isLiquidityRouter(msg.sender), Errors.PermissionDenied(msg.sender, address(this)));\n\n        // Get pool metadata and validate deposit conditions\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        _validateDeposit(pool);\n\n        uint256 oraclePrice;\n        // Update pool and user data\n        if (!pool.isCooked() && !pool.isPrimed() && !pool.isBoosted()) {\n            oraclePrice = _getOracle().safeOraclePrice(poolId);\n            _updatePool(pool, poolId, oraclePrice);\n            _updateUserData(pool, poolId, recipient);\n        }\n\n        // Transfer base tokens from user to this contract\n        IERC20 baseToken = IERC20(pool.baseToken);\n        baseToken.safeTransferFrom(user, address(this), amountIn);\n\n        IPoolVault.PoolReserve memory reserveInfo = IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).reserveInfo();\n        // Calculate total reserve and exchange rate for LP token minting\n        uint256 totalReserve = _currentTotalReserve(reserveInfo, pool, poolId, oraclePrice);\n        uint256 exchangeRate = _calculateExchangeRate(pool, totalReserve);\n        amountOut = _getLpAmountOut(pool, amountIn, exchangeRate);\n\n        // Validate minimum output amount\n        if (amountOut < minAmountOut) revert Errors.InsufficientOutputAmount();\n\n        // Ensure sufficient allowance for pool vault\n        if (baseToken.allowance(address(this), pool.poolVault) < amountIn) {\n            baseToken.forceApprove(pool.poolVault, type(uint256).max);\n        }\n        // Deposit base tokens to pool vault\n        IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).depositBaseToken(amountIn);\n        // Mint LP tokens to recipient\n        IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).mint(recipient, amountOut);\n\n        _getEmiter().emitPoolDeposited(\n            IEmiter.PoolDepositedParams({\n                poolId: poolId,\n                user: user,\n                recipient: recipient,\n                underlyingToken: pool.baseToken,\n                poolToken: pool.basePoolToken,\n                underlyingIn: amountIn,\n                poolTokenOut: amountOut,\n                oraclePrice: oraclePrice,\n                exchangeRate: exchangeRate,\n                poolTokenPrice: _computePoolTokenPrice(pool, poolId, exchangeRate, oraclePrice)\n            })\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function withdraw(\n        PoolId poolId,\n        uint256 amountIn,\n        uint256 minAmountOut,\n        address user,\n        address recipient\n    ) external override nonReentrant returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 rebateOut) {\n        require(user == msg.sender || _isLiquidityRouter(msg.sender), Errors.PermissionDenied(msg.sender, address(this)));\n\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        uint256 oraclePrice;\n        if (pool.isTrench() || pool.isPreBench()) {\n            oraclePrice = _getOracle().safeOraclePrice(poolId);\n            _updatePool(pool, poolId, oraclePrice);\n            _updateUserData(pool, poolId, user);\n        } else if (pool.isBench()) {\n            _updateUserData(pool, poolId, user);\n        }\n\n        // Get current pool reserve information\n        IPoolVault.PoolReserve memory reserveInfo = IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).reserveInfo();\n        // Calculate total reserve and exchange rate for base token withdrawal\n        uint256 totalReserve = _currentTotalReserve(reserveInfo, pool, poolId, oraclePrice);\n        uint256 exchangeRate = _calculateExchangeRate(pool, totalReserve);\n        uint256 lpSupply = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).totalSupply();\n        if (amountIn == lpSupply) {\n            amountOut = reserveInfo.baseTotalAmount - reserveInfo.baseReservedAmount;\n        } else {\n            amountOut = _getBaseAmountOut(pool, amountIn, exchangeRate);\n        }\n\n        // Validate minimum output amount against the final amountOut.\n        if (amountOut < minAmountOut) revert Errors.InsufficientOutputAmount();\n\n        // Burn LP tokens from user and withdraw base tokens from vault\n        IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).burnFrom(user, amountIn);\n        IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).withdrawBaseToken(amountOut, recipient);\n\n        // Calculate and transfer user rebates\n        rebateOut = _claimUserRebates(pool, poolId, user, recipient);\n\n        _getEmiter().emitPoolWithdrawn(\n            IEmiter.PoolWithdrawnParams({\n                poolId: poolId,\n                user: user,\n                recipient: recipient,\n                underlyingToken: pool.baseToken,\n                poolToken: pool.basePoolToken,\n                poolTokenIn: amountIn,\n                underlyingOut: amountOut,\n                rebateOut: rebateOut,\n                oraclePrice: oraclePrice,\n                exchangeRate: exchangeRate,\n                poolTokenPrice: _computePoolTokenPrice(pool, poolId, exchangeRate, oraclePrice)\n            })\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function claimUserRebate(PoolId poolId, address user, address recipient) external override nonReentrant returns (uint256 rebateOut) {\n        require(user == msg.sender || _isLiquidityRouter(msg.sender), Errors.PermissionDenied(msg.sender, address(this)));\n        return _claim(poolId, user, recipient);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function claimUserRebates(\n        PoolId[] calldata poolIds,\n        address user,\n        address recipient\n    ) external override nonReentrant returns (uint256[] memory rebateOut) {\n        require(user == msg.sender || _isLiquidityRouter(msg.sender), Errors.PermissionDenied(msg.sender, address(this)));\n\n        rebateOut = new uint256[](poolIds.length);\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < poolIds.length; ++i) {\n            rebateOut[i] = _claim(poolIds[i], user, recipient);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function updateWeightedIndexOnTransfer(PoolId poolId, address from, address to, uint256 amount, uint256 toBalanceBefore) external override {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        require(msg.sender == pool.basePoolToken, Errors.PermissionDenied(msg.sender, address(this)));\n\n        // Skip if pool is in these states (no rebates)\n        if (pool.isCooked() || pool.isBoosted() || pool.isPrimed()) return;\n\n        // Get sender's current rebate index\n        uint256 fromIndex = _userDatas[poolId][from].index;\n        UserData storage toUserData = _userDatas[poolId][to];\n        if (toBalanceBefore == 0) {\n            // Receiver is new user or has zero balance - directly inherit sender's index\n            toUserData.index = fromIndex;\n        } else {\n            // Calculate weighted average index for regular rebates\n            toUserData.index = (toUserData.index * toBalanceBefore + fromIndex * amount) / (toBalanceBefore + amount);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function exchangeProfit(\n        PoolId poolId,\n        uint256 baseIn,\n        uint256 minQuoteOut,\n        address recipient,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) external override nonReentrant returns (uint256 quoteOut) {\n        // Get pool metadata and validate compound is enabled\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        require(pool.compoundEnabled, Errors.PoolNotCompoundable(poolId));\n\n        // Check if there are available profits to exchange\n        uint256 profits = _poolDatas[poolId].exchangeableProfits;\n        require(profits > 0, ExceedMaxProfit());\n\n        // Get current oracle price for calculations\n        uint256 oraclePrice = _getOracle().safeOraclePrice(poolId);\n\n        // Calculate quote output with incentive rate from risk parameters\n        IRiskParameter.PoolConfigParams memory poolRiskConfig = _getRiskParameter().getPoolConfigParams(pool.riskTier);\n        uint256 exchangePrice = oraclePrice.mulPrecision(\n            Constants.INCENTIVE_RATE_PRECISION + poolRiskConfig.exchangeIncentiveRate,\n            Constants.INCENTIVE_RATE_PRECISION\n        );\n        quoteOut = TradingHelper.convertTokenAmount(pool.baseToken, pool.quoteToken, baseIn.mulPrice(exchangePrice));\n        // Validate output amounts against limits\n        require(quoteOut <= profits, ExceedMaxProfit());\n        require(quoteOut >= minQuoteOut, Errors.ExceedMinOutputAmount());\n\n        _poolDatas[poolId].exchangeableProfits -= quoteOut;\n\n        // Transfer quote tokens to recipient\n        IERC20(pool.quoteToken).safeTransfer(recipient, quoteOut);\n\n        uint256 balanceBefore = IERC20(pool.baseToken).balanceOf(address(this));\n        IExchangeCallback(msg.sender).onExchange(poolId, pool.baseToken, baseIn, data);\n        uint256 balanceAfter = IERC20(pool.baseToken).balanceOf(address(this));\n        require(balanceAfter - balanceBefore == baseIn, Errors.InsufficientReturnAmount(baseIn, balanceAfter - balanceBefore));\n\n        // Ensure sufficient allowance for pool vault and deposit base tokens\n        if (IERC20(pool.baseToken).allowance(address(this), pool.poolVault) < baseIn) {\n            IERC20(pool.baseToken).forceApprove(pool.poolVault, type(uint256).max);\n        }\n        IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).depositBaseToken(baseIn);\n\n        emit PoolProfitExchanged(poolId, baseIn, quoteOut, oraclePrice, recipient);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IBasePool\n    function distribute(\n        PoolId poolId,\n        uint256 baseAmount,\n        uint256 quoteAmount,\n        uint256 genesisAmount,\n        uint256 price\n    ) external override onlyPoolVault(poolId) {\n        // Get pool metadata for distribution calculations\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n\n        // Add quote amount to exchangeable profits\n        _poolDatas[poolId].exchangeableProfits += quoteAmount;\n\n        // Calculate and update genesis rebate index\n        (, uint256 newGenesisIndex) = _calculateGenesisRebateIndex(pool, poolId, genesisAmount);\n        _poolDatas[poolId].genesisRebateIndex = newGenesisIndex;\n\n        // Get current oracle price and calculate exchange rate\n        uint256 exchangeRate = _getExchangeRate(pool, poolId, price);\n\n        // Emit profit distribution event\n        emit BasePoolProfitDistributed(poolId, baseAmount, quoteAmount, price, exchangeRate, _poolDatas[poolId].rebateIndex, newGenesisIndex);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Updates pool data\n     * @param poolId Pool ID\n     * @param oraclePrice Current oracle price\n     */\n    function updatePool(PoolId poolId, uint256 oraclePrice) external override onlyPoolManager {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        _updatePool(pool, poolId, oraclePrice);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Updates pool profit distribution\n     * @param pool Pool metadata\n     * @param poolId Pool ID for updates\n     * @param oraclePrice Current oracle price\n     */\n    function _updatePool(PoolMetadata memory pool, PoolId poolId, uint256 oraclePrice) internal {\n        // Distribute pool profits\n        ITradingVault(pool.tradingVault).distributePoolProfit(oraclePrice);\n\n        // Get remaining profits and reset to zero\n        uint256 unexchangedProfits = _poolDatas[poolId].exchangeableProfits;\n        _poolDatas[poolId].exchangeableProfits = 0;\n\n        // Calculate new rebate index based on remaining profits\n        (uint256 oldIndex, uint256 newIndex) = _calculateRebateIndex(pool, poolId, unexchangedProfits);\n        _poolDatas[poolId].rebateIndex = newIndex;\n\n        emit PoolRebateIndexUpdated(poolId, unexchangedProfits, oldIndex, newIndex);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Updates user's rebate data and accrues pending rebates\n     * @param pool Pool metadata\n     * @param poolId The pool ID\n     * @param user User address to update\n     */\n    function _updateUserData(PoolMetadata memory pool, PoolId poolId, address user) internal {\n        // Get current pool and user data\n        PoolData memory poolData = _poolDatas[poolId];\n        UserData storage userData = _userDatas[poolId][user];\n\n        // Calculate accrued rebates based on user's LP token balance\n        uint256 accrued;\n        uint256 tokenBalance = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).balanceOf(user);\n        if (tokenBalance > 0) {\n            accrued = _getRebates(poolData.rebateIndex, userData.index, tokenBalance);\n        }\n\n        // Get user's genesis share for genesis rebates\n        uint256 genesisAccrued;\n        uint256 genesisShare = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).userGenesisShare(user);\n        if (genesisShare > 0) {\n            genesisAccrued = _getRebates(poolData.genesisRebateIndex, userData.genesisIndex, genesisShare);\n        }\n\n        userData.index = poolData.rebateIndex;\n        userData.genesisIndex = poolData.genesisRebateIndex;\n        userData.accrued += accrued;\n        userData.genesisAccrued += genesisAccrued;\n    }\n\n    function _claim(PoolId poolId, address user, address recipient) internal returns (uint256 rebateOut) {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        if (pool.isTrench() || pool.isPreBench()) {\n            _updatePool(pool, poolId, _getOracle().safeOraclePrice(poolId));\n            _updateUserData(pool, poolId, user);\n        } else if (pool.isBench()) {\n            _updateUserData(pool, poolId, user);\n        }\n\n        rebateOut = _claimUserRebates(pool, poolId, user, recipient);\n    }\n\n    function _claimUserRebates(PoolMetadata memory pool, PoolId poolId, address user, address recipient) internal returns (uint256 rebateOut) {\n        UserData storage userData = _userDatas[poolId][user];\n        rebateOut = userData.accrued + userData.genesisAccrued;\n        if (rebateOut == 0) return rebateOut;\n\n        userData.accrued = 0;\n        userData.genesisAccrued = 0;\n        IERC20(pool.quoteToken).safeTransfer(recipient, rebateOut);\n\n        _getEmiter().emitPoolRebateClaimed(IEmiter.PoolRebateClaimedParams({ poolId: poolId, user: user, recipient: recipient, amount: rebateOut }));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Validates that a deposit operation can be performed\n     * @param pool Pool metadata to validate\n     */\n    function _validateDeposit(PoolMetadata memory pool) internal pure {\n        require(pool.isPoolInitialized(), Errors.PoolNotExist(pool.poolId));\n        require(!pool.isPreBench() && !pool.isBench(), Errors.PoolNotActive(pool.poolId));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Calculates the current total reserve of the pool, including debt collateral\n     * @param reserveInfo Pool reserve information\n     * @param pool Pool metadata\n     * @param poolId Pool ID\n     * @return totalReserve Current total reserve of the pool\n     */\n    function _currentTotalReserve(\n        IPoolVault.PoolReserve memory reserveInfo,\n        PoolMetadata memory pool,\n        PoolId poolId,\n        uint256 price\n    ) internal view returns (uint256 totalReserve) {\n        totalReserve = reserveInfo.baseTotalAmount;\n\n        if (pool.isTrench() || pool.isPreBench()) {\n            ITradingVault.DebtInfo memory debtInfo = ITradingVault(pool.tradingVault).debtInfo();\n            if (debtInfo.totalDebt > 0) {\n                IRiskParameter.PoolConfigParams memory poolRiskConfig = _getRiskParameter().getPoolConfigParams(pool.riskTier);\n\n                uint256 debtBase = TradingHelper.convertTokenAmount(\n                    pool.quoteToken,\n                    pool.baseToken,\n                    debtInfo.totalDebt.divPrice(\n                        price.mulPrecision(\n                            Constants.INCENTIVE_RATE_PRECISION - poolRiskConfig.exchangeIncentiveRate,\n                            Constants.INCENTIVE_RATE_PRECISION\n                        )\n                    )\n                );\n                // debtBase is the base token amount that is needed to cover the debt\n                // so we need to subtract it from the total reserve\n                // Due to the early closing mechanism, debt will not exceed the total reserves\n                totalReserve = totalReserve + debtInfo.baseCollateral - debtBase; // / supply\n            }\n\n            (, int256 unrealizedPnl, ) = _pendingPoolPNL(pool, poolId, price);\n            if (unrealizedPnl != 0) {\n                // Clamp to zero if unrealized losses exceed total reserves\n                if (unrealizedPnl < 0 && unrealizedPnl.abs() > totalReserve) {\n                    return 0;\n                }\n\n                totalReserve = unrealizedPnl > 0 ? totalReserve + uint256(unrealizedPnl) : totalReserve - unrealizedPnl.abs();\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Calculates pending base rebates for a user\n     * @param poolId The pool ID to check rebates for\n     * @param price Current oracle price\n     * @param user Address of the user\n     * @return rebates Regular rebates earned\n     * @return genesisRebates Genesis rebates earned\n     */\n    function _pendingUserBaseRebate(\n        PoolMetadata memory pool,\n        PoolId poolId,\n        uint256 price,\n        address user\n    ) internal view returns (uint256 rebates, uint256 genesisRebates) {\n        if (pool.isCooked() || pool.isPrimed() || pool.isBoosted()) return (0, 0);\n        UserData memory userData = _userDatas[poolId][user];\n\n        (uint256 quoteProfits, uint256 genesisQuoteProfits) = _pendingPoolProfits(pool, price);\n        uint256 userBalance = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).balanceOf(user);\n        if (userBalance > 0) {\n            (, uint256 newIndex) = _calculateRebateIndex(pool, poolId, quoteProfits);\n            rebates = _getRebates(newIndex, userData.index, userBalance);\n        }\n\n        uint256 genesisShare = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).userGenesisShare(user);\n        if (genesisShare > 0) {\n            (, uint256 newGenesisIndex) = _calculateGenesisRebateIndex(pool, poolId, genesisQuoteProfits);\n            genesisRebates = _getRebates(newGenesisIndex, userData.genesisIndex, genesisShare);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Calculates the new rebate index for regular rebates\n     * @param poolId The pool ID\n     * @param profits Amount of profits to distribute\n     * @return oldIndex Previous rebate index\n     * @return newIndex New rebate index after adding profits\n     */\n    function _calculateRebateIndex(\n        PoolMetadata memory pool,\n        PoolId poolId,\n        uint256 profits\n    ) internal view returns (uint256 oldIndex, uint256 newIndex) {\n        oldIndex = _poolDatas[poolId].rebateIndex;\n        uint256 totalSupply = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).totalSupply();\n        if (totalSupply == 0) return (oldIndex, oldIndex);\n\n        uint8 decimals = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).decimals();\n        newIndex = oldIndex + ((profits * REBATE_INDEX_PRECISION * (10 ** decimals)) / totalSupply);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Calculates the new rebate index for genesis rebates\n     * @param poolId The pool ID\n     * @param genesisProfits Amount of genesis profits to distribute\n     * @return oldIndex Previous genesis rebate index\n     * @return newIndex New genesis rebate index after adding profits\n     */\n    function _calculateGenesisRebateIndex(\n        PoolMetadata memory pool,\n        PoolId poolId,\n        uint256 genesisProfits\n    ) internal view returns (uint256 oldIndex, uint256 newIndex) {\n        oldIndex = _poolDatas[poolId].genesisRebateIndex;\n        uint256 totalGenesisShare = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).totalGenesisShare();\n        if (totalGenesisShare == 0) return (oldIndex, oldIndex);\n\n        uint8 decimals = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).decimals();\n        newIndex = oldIndex + ((genesisProfits * REBATE_INDEX_PRECISION * (10 ** decimals)) / totalGenesisShare);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Calculates pending pool profits for the pool\n     * @param pool Pool metadata\n     * @param price Current oracle price\n     * @return quoteAmount Amount of quote tokens for regular rebates\n     * @return genesisQuoteAmount Amount of quote tokens for genesis rebates\n     */\n    function _pendingPoolProfits(PoolMetadata memory pool, uint256 price) internal view returns (uint256 quoteAmount, uint256 genesisQuoteAmount) {\n        ITradingVault.PoolProfit memory profit = ITradingVault(pool.tradingVault).pendingPoolProfit();\n        if (profit.profits == 0 && profit.genesisProfits == 0) return (0, 0);\n\n        (uint256 expectBaseProfit, , ) = IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).splitPoolProfits(profit.profits, price);\n        (uint256 expectGenesisBaseProfit, , ) = IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).splitPoolProfits(profit.genesisProfits, price);\n\n        ITradingVault.DebtInfo memory debtInfo = ITradingVault(pool.tradingVault).debtInfo();\n        if (debtInfo.totalDebt > 0) {\n            expectBaseProfit = expectBaseProfit > debtInfo.totalDebt ? expectBaseProfit - debtInfo.totalDebt : 0;\n        }\n        return (expectBaseProfit, expectGenesisBaseProfit);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc PoolBase\n    function _getExchangeRate(PoolMetadata memory pool, PoolId poolId, uint256 price) internal view override returns (uint256) {\n        IPoolVault.PoolReserve memory reserveInfo = IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).reserveInfo();\n        uint256 totalReserve = _currentTotalReserve(reserveInfo, pool, poolId, price);\n        return _calculateExchangeRate(pool, totalReserve);\n    }\n\n    function _computePoolTokenPrice(\n        PoolMetadata memory pool,\n        PoolId /* poolId */,\n        uint256 exchangeRate,\n        uint256 price\n    ) internal view override returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 lpPrice = exchangeRate.mulPrecision(price, EXCHANGE_RATE_PRECISION);\n\n        ITradingVault.PoolProfit memory profit = ITradingVault(pool.tradingVault).pendingPoolProfit();\n        if (profit.profits > 0) {\n            (uint256 expectBaseProfit, , ) = IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).splitPoolProfits(profit.profits, price);\n            uint256 totalSupply = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).totalSupply();\n            if (totalSupply > 0) {\n                lpPrice +=\n                    (TradingHelper.convertTokenToDecimals(pool.quoteToken, POOL_TOKEN_DECIMALS, expectBaseProfit) * Constants.PRICE_PRECISION) /\n                    totalSupply;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return lpPrice;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Calculates exchange rate based on base token amount and total supply\n     * @param pool Pool metadata\n     * @param baseAmount Total base token amount\n     * @return Exchange rate with EXCHANGE_RATE_PRECISION decimals\n     */\n    function _calculateExchangeRate(PoolMetadata memory pool, uint256 baseAmount) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 totalSupply = IPoolToken(pool.basePoolToken).totalSupply();\n        uint256 normalizedBaseAmount = TradingHelper.convertTokenToDecimals(pool.baseToken, POOL_TOKEN_DECIMALS, baseAmount);\n        return _virtualizedExchangeRate(normalizedBaseAmount, totalSupply);\n    }\n\n    function _exchangeableProfit(PoolId poolId, uint256 price) internal view returns (uint256 baseIn, uint256 quoteOut) {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n\n        uint256 exchangeableProfit = _poolDatas[poolId].exchangeableProfits;\n        if (exchangeableProfit == 0) return (0, 0);\n\n        IRiskParameter.PoolConfigParams memory poolRiskConfig = _getRiskParameter().getPoolConfigParams(pool.riskTier);\n        uint256 exchangePrice = price.mulPrecision(\n            Constants.INCENTIVE_RATE_PRECISION + poolRiskConfig.exchangeIncentiveRate,\n            Constants.INCENTIVE_RATE_PRECISION\n        );\n        baseIn = TradingHelper.convertTokenAmount(pool.quoteToken, pool.baseToken, exchangeableProfit.divPrice(exchangePrice));\n        quoteOut = TradingHelper.convertTokenAmount(pool.baseToken, pool.quoteToken, baseIn.mulPrice(exchangePrice));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Calculates LP token amount for a given base token input\n     * @param pool Pool metadata\n     * @param amount Amount of base tokens\n     * @param exchangeRate Current exchange rate\n     * @return Amount of LP tokens to mint\n     */\n    function _getLpAmountOut(PoolMetadata memory pool, uint256 amount, uint256 exchangeRate) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        if (exchangeRate == 0) return 0;\n        return TradingHelper.convertTokenToDecimals(pool.baseToken, POOL_TOKEN_DECIMALS, (amount * EXCHANGE_RATE_PRECISION) / exchangeRate);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Calculates base token amount for a given LP token input\n     * @param pool Pool metadata\n     * @param amount Amount of LP tokens\n     * @param exchangeRate Current exchange rate\n     * @return Amount of base tokens to withdraw\n     */\n    function _getBaseAmountOut(PoolMetadata memory pool, uint256 amount, uint256 exchangeRate) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return TradingHelper.convertTokenFromDecimals(POOL_TOKEN_DECIMALS, pool.baseToken, (amount * exchangeRate) / EXCHANGE_RATE_PRECISION);\n    }\n\n    function _onlyPoolVault(PoolId poolId) internal view {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        require(msg.sender == pool.poolVault, Errors.PermissionDenied(msg.sender, address(this)));\n    }\n\n    function _onlyPoolManager() internal view {\n        require(msg.sender == _getDependencyAddress(Identifier.POOL_MANAGER), Errors.PermissionDenied(msg.sender, address(this)));\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x95703f3d89f5120e7c7fa17ab1978625b5da7902a39e9a020084ffc9c3ee52e7","license":"BUSL-1.1"},"myx-contract-v2/src/pool/PoolBase.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1\npragma solidity ^0.8.30;\n\nimport { SignedMath } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/SignedMath.sol\";\nimport { IEmiter } from \"./../interfaces/IEmiter.sol\";\nimport { IFundingRate } from \"./../interfaces/IFundingRate.sol\";\nimport { IOracle } from \"./../interfaces/IOracle.sol\";\nimport { IPoolBase } from \"./../interfaces/IPoolBase.sol\";\nimport { IPoolManager } from \"./../interfaces/IPoolManager.sol\";\nimport { IPoolVault } from \"./../interfaces/IPoolVault.sol\";\nimport { IPositionManager } from \"./../interfaces/IPositionManager.sol\";\nimport { IRiskParameter } from \"./../interfaces/IRiskParameter.sol\";\nimport { Identifier } from \"./../libraries/Identifier.sol\";\nimport { TradingHelper } from \"./../libraries/TradingHelper.sol\";\nimport { BaseContractUpgradeable } from \"./../misc/base/BaseContractUpgradeable.sol\";\nimport { PoolMetadata, PoolId, Direction, Errors } from \"./../types/Types.sol\";\n\nabstract contract PoolBase is BaseContractUpgradeable, IPoolBase {\n    using SignedMath for int256;\n\n    // Precision used for exchange rate calculations (18 decimals)\n    uint256 public constant EXCHANGE_RATE_PRECISION = 1e18;\n    // Precision used for rebate index calculations (18 decimals)\n    uint256 public constant REBATE_INDEX_PRECISION = 1e18;\n    // Standard decimals for pool tokens\n    uint8 public constant POOL_TOKEN_DECIMALS = 18;\n    // Virtual liquidity offsets used to harden empty-pool pricing without minting dead shares.\n    uint256 public constant VIRTUAL_SHARES = 1e3;\n    uint256 public constant VIRTUAL_ASSETS = 1e3;\n\n    function __PoolBase_init(address addressManager) internal onlyInitializing {\n        bytes32[] memory identifiers = new bytes32[](7);\n        identifiers[0] = Identifier.POOL_MANAGER;\n        identifiers[1] = Identifier.ORACLE;\n        identifiers[2] = Identifier.EMITER;\n        identifiers[3] = Identifier.LIQUIDITY_ROUTER;\n        identifiers[4] = Identifier.RISK_PARAMETER;\n        identifiers[5] = Identifier.POSITION_MANAGER;\n        identifiers[6] = Identifier.FUNDING_RATE;\n        __BaseContractUpgradeable_init(addressManager, identifiers);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPoolBase\n    function getExchangeRate(PoolId poolId) public view override returns (uint256) {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        uint256 oraclePrice = _getOracle().safeOraclePrice(poolId);\n        return _getExchangeRate(pool, poolId, oraclePrice);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPoolBase\n    function getExchangeRate(PoolId poolId, uint256 price) public view override returns (uint256) {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        return _getExchangeRate(pool, poolId, price);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPoolBase\n    function getPoolTokenPrice(PoolId poolId, uint256 price) public view override returns (uint256) {\n        PoolMetadata memory pool = _getPoolManager().getPool(poolId);\n        uint256 exchangeRate = _getExchangeRate(pool, poolId, price);\n        return _computePoolTokenPrice(pool, poolId, exchangeRate, price);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPoolBase\n    function previewPoolTokenPrice(PoolId poolId) external view override returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 oraclePrice = _getOracle().safeOraclePrice(poolId);\n        return getPoolTokenPrice(poolId, oraclePrice);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Calculates pending pool PNL\n     * @return unrealizedPnl Pending pool PNL\n     * @return baseAmount Pending pool base pnl amount\n     * @return quoteAmount Pending pool quote pnl amount\n     */\n    function _pendingPoolPNL(\n        PoolMetadata memory pool,\n        PoolId poolId,\n        uint256 price\n    ) internal view returns (int256 unrealizedPnl, int256 baseAmount, int256 quoteAmount) {\n        IPositionManager.OITracker memory oi = _getPositionManager().getOITracker(poolId);\n        unrealizedPnl = TradingHelper.calculatePNL(pool, oi.poolEntryPrice, price, oi.tracker.abs(), oi.tracker < 0);\n        if (unrealizedPnl != 0) {\n            (, uint256 quoteSize, uint256 baseSize) = IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).splitPoolProfits(unrealizedPnl.abs(), price);\n\n            int256 sign = unrealizedPnl > 0 ? int256(1) : int256(-1);\n            baseAmount = sign * int256(baseSize);\n            quoteAmount = sign * int256(quoteSize);\n        }\n\n        uint256 fundingFee = _calculatePoolFundingFee(pool, oi, poolId, price);\n        if (fundingFee > 0) {\n            (, uint256 quoteSize, uint256 baseSize) = IPoolVault(pool.poolVault).splitPoolProfits(fundingFee, price);\n            baseAmount += int256(baseSize);\n            quoteAmount += int256(quoteSize);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Gets the current exchange rate including pending profits\n     * @param pool Pool metadata\n     * @param poolId The pool ID\n     * @param price Current price\n     * @return Current exchange rate with pending profits included\n     */\n      oi.tracker > 0 ? require(fundingFee >= 0, Errors.PoolFundingFeeNotPositive());\n        return uint256(fundingFee);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Calculates rebates earned by a user based on index difference\n BUSL-1.1\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport { Constants, Operation, Direction, TriggerType } from \"./../types/Types.sol\";\nimport { PrecisionUtils } from \"./PrecisionUtils.sol\";\n\n/// @title TradeUtils\n/// @notice Utility library for trading operations and calculations\nlibrary TradeUtils {\n    using PrecisionUtils for uint256;\n\n    /// @notice Determine if an order is a buy order\n    /// @param operation Order operation (Increase/Decrease)\n    /// @param direction Order direction (Long/Short)\n    /// @return isBuy True if the order is a buy order\n    function getOrderSide(Operation operation, Direction direction) internal pure returns (bool isBuy) {\n        return (operation == Operation.Increase && direction == Direction.Long) || (operation == Operation.Decrease && direction == Direction.Short);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Get the trigger type for an order based on operation and direction\n    /// @param operation Order operation (Increase/Decrease)\n    /// @param direction Order direction (Long/Short)\n    /// @return triggerType The appropriate trigger type for the order\n    function getOrderTriggerType(Operation operation, Direction direction) internal pure returns (TriggerType triggerType) {\n        if (operation == Operation.Increase) {\n            if (direction == Direction.Long) return TriggerType.LTE;\n            else if (direction == Direction.Short) return TriggerType.GTE;\n        } else if (operation == Operation.Decrease) {\n            if (direction == Direction.Long) return TriggerType.GTE;\n            else if (direction == Direction.Short) return TriggerType.LTE;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Get the trigger type for take profit or stop loss orders\n    /// @param direction Order direction (Long/Short)\n    /// @param isTakeProfit True for take profit, false for stop loss\n    /// @return triggerType The appropriate trigger type for TPSL orders\n    function getTPSLTriggerType(Direction direction, bool isTakeProfit) internal pure returns (TriggerType triggerType) {\n        if (direction == Direction.Long) {\n            return isTakeProfit ? TriggerType.GTE : TriggerType.LTE;\n        } else {\n            return isTakeProfit ? TriggerType.LTE : TriggerType.GTE;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Validate if order slippage is within acceptable range\n    /// @param operation Order operation (Increase/Decrease)\n    /// @param direction Order direction (Long/Short)\n    /// @param orderPrice Order price\n    /// @param marketPrice Current market price\n    /// @param slippagePct Maximum allowed slippage percentage\n    /// @return True if slippage is acceptable\n    function validateOrderSlippage(\n        Operation operation,\n        Direction direction,\n        uint256 orderPrice,\n        uint256 marketPrice,\n        uint16 slippagePct\n    ) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        bool isBuy = getOrderSide(operation, direction);\n        if (isBuy) {\n            return marketPrice <= (orderPrice * (Constants.SLIPPAGE_PRECISION + slippagePct)) / Constants.SLIPPAGE_PRECISION;\n        } else {\n            return marketPrice >= (orderPrice * (Constants.SLIPPAGE_PRECISION - slippagePct)) / Constants.SLIPPAGE_PRECISION;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Calculate the weighted average entry price for a position\n    /// @param currentSize Current position size\n    /// @param currentPrice Current entry price\n    /// @param addedSize Additional size to add\n    /// @param addedPrice Price for additional size\n    /// @return Weighted average entry price\n    function calculateEntryPrice(\n        uint256 currentSize,\n        uint256 currentPrice,\n        uint256 addedSize,\n        uint256 addedPrice,\n        uint8 tokenDecimals\n    ) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 totalSizeWad = (currentSize + addedSize).toWad(tokenDecimals);\n        uint256 totalValueWad = currentSize.toWad(tokenDecimals).mulPrice(currentPrice) + addedSize.toWad(tokenDecimals).mulPrice(addedPrice);\n        return totalValueWad.divPrice(totalSizeWad);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Calculate profit and loss for a position\n    /// @param entryPrice Position entry price\n    /// @param exitPrice Position exit price\n    /// @param size Position size\n    /// @param isLong True if long position, false if short\n    /// @return pnl Profit and loss amount (positive for profit, negative for loss)\n    function calculatePNLSize(uint256 entryPrice, uint256 exitPrice, uint256 size, bool isLong) internal pure returns (int256 pnl) {\n        uint256 priceDiff = entryPrice > exitPrice ? entryPrice - exitPrice : exitPrice - entryPrice;\n        uint256 pnlAmount = size.mulPrice(priceDiff);\n        bool isProfit = (isLong && exitPrice >= entryPrice) || (!isLong && entryPrice >= exitPrice);\n        return isProfit ? int256(pnlAmount) : -int256(pnlAmount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Calculate funding fee for a position\n    /// @param accruedFundingTracker Accumulated funding tracker\n    /// @param positionSize Position size\n    /// @param direction Position direction (Long/Short)\n    /// @return Funding fee amount\n    function calculateFundingFeeSize(int256 accruedFundingTracker, uint256 positionSize, Direction direction) internal pure returns (int256) {\n        int256 signedTracker = direction == Direction.Long ? -accruedFundingTracker : accruedFundingTracker;\n        return (signedTracker * int256(positionSize)) / int256(Constants.FUNDING_RATE_PRECISION);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x648f7ec0f6d40d989a67cc3a4c88e7f7178253fe7c24033564aca9ef4ab38f47","license":"BUSL-1.1"}},"version":1}

IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas.
